idea-plugin.name: HumanEye
idea-plugin.description:
Make code written by agents easier to parse for you, the reader by folding durable, agent-directed maintenance comments.

HumanEye recognizes the @agent-context convention, keeps context colocated with code, and provides hidden, all, and per-type visibility filters. Runs locally without an AI service or account.

To help your coding agent write these annotations, add the HumanEye instruction template to your project's AGENTS.md, creating that file if needed. If the project already has a CLAUDE.md, add the template there too. The plugin itself does not edit instruction files.

action.description: Show or fold agent-context annotations by type
